changesets.name: optional-fleet-review.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/work-fleet": minor
---

### Added

- Set `review: false` in Fleet configuration to send delivered PRs straight to required checks and human merge readiness. The setting reloads for results that have not entered review; enabled or omitted keeps independent review.

changesets.name: quality-baseline-shards.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/quality": minor
---

### Changed

- Store baseline debt in package shards and a root `quality-baseline.jsonl`, remove empty shards, and keep tighten, prune and lint on the same records. Migrate a single-file baseline with `quality baseline migrate --from quality/baseline.jsonl`.
- Merge baseline entries by path and rule: removals win, retained counts take the minimum and additions from both sides survive. Configure the checkout with `quality baseline install-driver` and register `merge=quality-baseline` for shard files in `.gitattributes`. The source exports are `mergeBaseline(base, ours, theirs)` in `baseline/merge.ts`, `installDriver(cwd, launch)` in `baseline/installDriver.ts`, and `SHARD_NAME`, `Shard`, `shardOf(file, rootFile)`, `shardPaths(config)` and `saveShards(config, before, entries)` in `baseline/shards.ts`.

### Breaking

- `BaselineFile` from `engine/baselineFile.ts` exposes `files: ReadonlyMap<string, Shard>` instead of a single `raw` string. Read each shard's `raw` and `entries` from `files`; the combined `entries` field remains available.

changesets.name: work-board-pull-requests.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/work-board": minor
---

### Added

- A Pull requests page groups Fleet's current PRs with ready-to-merge work first, links PR numbers and Board task titles, and shows time in each state. Its navigation badge counts PRs waiting for a merge and updates with Fleet's live state.
- Board's Fleet item projection exposes an optional `readyToMerge` flag derived from Fleet's current published merge decision.

changesets.name: work-fleet-closed-released.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/work-fleet": patch
---

### Fixed

- Treat dropped Board tasks as closed when releasing prepared or stopped work, refreshing briefs and closing decisions; never admit closed tasks.
- Re-admit released tasks without a merged delivery on the next admission pass while they remain approved and open, preserving prior cycles and PR reservations so their dependents can proceed after delivery.
